facts.fact: The Springer study says the Somali Ministry of Education has recently taken steps to close education system gaps through EMIS application, and surveys 210 users on its effectiveness.

The World Bank amendment to Grant D837-SO describes project support for operationalization and expansion of the EMIS, and expansion of the Teacher Management Information System integrated with the EMIS.

systems.tiers: all levels of the education system

facts.fact: The Joint Education Sector Review report of the Ministry of Education says it incorporates quantitative data from the Education Management Information System (EMIS).
GPE says the EMIS, initiated in 2016 by MOECHE, collects and analyzes data from schools on an annual basis, and all primary schools in the Federal Member States and Banaadir are registered in it.

systems.tiers: federal, Federal Member State, district and school

facts.fact: The World Bank restructuring paper says the EMIS platform piloted by MoECHE has become functional and technically sound, with EMIS enhancement and integration of an enhanced Teacher Management Information System planned for delivery in April 2026.

note: Nothing on an education management system.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's terms of reference say its online EMIS, rolled out nationwide in 2019, has integrated primary (grades 4-8 only), secondary and alternative basic education into a centralized digital platform for collecting, storing and analysing education data.

The Ministry's Directorate of Basic Education invited proposals by 22 July 2025 for revision and expansion of the EMIS to add individual student-level data and cover grades 1-3, early childhood, TVET and national examination records.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Culture and Higher Education

note: The HSC is a certificate service, not the national EMIS; the EMIS department only leads it.
